data.title: Implement S2.1 — sources + artifacts tables with citation backfill
data.description: Create `sources` + `artifacts` tables per ADR 0001 (BCE-safe dateInstant + precision, reliability note, transcript/translation/image). One-shot backfill from `story_segments.citations` so slice-1 inline citations are preserved. Refs: docs/engineering/adr/0001-sources-artifacts-schema.md, docs/product/prd/s2-artifact-grounding.md.

data.title: Implement S2.2 — story_artifacts + moment_artifacts + segment_citations joins
data.description: The reuse layer: one artifact, many beats/stories; composite PKs; artifact-first browse back to everything it anchors. Per ADR 0001.

data.title: Implement S2.3 — register_artifact MCP tool + write_story v2 artifact refs
data.description: Grounded generation: write_story beats reference pre-registered artifacts by id; register_artifact writes the reusable rows. Beats name their source.

data.title: Implement S2.4 — artifact UX (beat tap → artifact card, artifact-first browse)
data.description: Tap a cited beat sentence → artifact card (transcript/translation/image/reliability); artifact library browse → anchored stories; optional canvas lens for dated artifacts.

data.title: Implement S2.5 — search_artifacts MCP tool (FTS5 lexical recall)
data.description: SQLite FTS5 over artifacts.title/transcript/translation so Claude can recall a prior artifact in a later session and re-ground new work. Lexical first; embeddings deferred per ADR 0001. Validates bet B4.

data.title: Record the 60-second Stoicism demo (the North Star artifact)
data.description: Claude left, Synek right; 'map Stoicism for me'; canvas populates live with faces, eras, a story on tap. Drive writes through the HTTP MCP endpoint (not stdio) so the SSE bus fires. Validates bet B2.

data.title: Run the owed live in-browser UI pass
data.description: Claude Preview cannot hydrate the TanStack Start dev server; a normal browser session is owed to verify SSE live-build, story reader, ⌘K, and panel modes end-to-end before recording the demo.

data.title: Run the lovable-gate experiment (invite ~10, measure week-2 unprompted return)
data.description: Invite ~10 primary-persona users; track setup survival (bet B1) and week-2+ unprompted return. Gate: >=3 return. Honest-mode measurement: self-report/conversation, no silent telemetry. Defined in docs/product/product-strategy.md.

data.title: Implement S3 — multi-POV stories (cast join, POV-constrained generation, switcher)
data.description: S3.1 story_people cast join; S3.2 POV-constrained generation (epistemic vantage); S3.3 POV switcher + 'Add a perspective'. Depends on S2 grounding. Refs: docs/product/prd/s3-multi-pov.md.

data.title: Implement S3.4 — 'Talk to {entity}' button (verb #1)
data.description: Pre-filled copyable first-person prompt on entity/person panels; POV lands via write_story + story_people. Front door to S3 and verb #1 of the NEXT.5 system. Can ship ahead of S3.1-S3.3. buildTalkToPrompt already exists (shipped in ⌘K); this surfaces it on the node panel. Spec: docs/product/prd/next5-verb-system.md (Tier 1). Parallel-safe with S2 (different NodeDetailPanel region).

data.title: Implement NEXT.5 Tier 1 — node-panel verb action row
data.description: DONE (build-verified 2026-06-12; live in-browser pass owed via local-62). verbs.ts grown into a descriptor registry (Verb type: id/family/icon/keywords/label/showWhen/makeSpec + NODE_VERBS). 5 node verbs: Talk-to (interact), Expand around this, Improve this {type}, Write a story here, What else was happening (event/period-gated). New builders in node-verb-prompts.ts (expand/improve-node/whats-happening); write-story reuses buildStoryPrompt. NodeVerbBar renders verbsForNode() in the panel (excludes write-story — Story section covers it). ⌘K shows the SELECTED node's verbs at the TOP under a 'Verbs' group, keyword-matchable. Single verb_prompt_copied analytics event keyed by verb_id+surface (replaced talk_to/improve specific events) so bet B5 copy-rates self-prioritize Tier 2/3. Spec: docs/product/prd/next5-verb-system.md.

data.title: Implement VERBS-T2 gap invitations (the alive-canvas demo centerpiece)
data.description: DONE (build-verified 2026-06-12; live in-browser pass owed via local-62). Shared gap rule extracted to src/lib/domain/dead-zones.ts (findDeadZones, DEAD_ZONE_THRESHOLD 0.15) — layout-report.ts now imports it (no drift; logic-tested). GapInvitationNode (dashed ghost card) added as a `gap` React Flow node type; rfNodes memo pushes one per dead zone (LINEAR mode only), filtered for period-coverage, capped at 4 (MAX_GAP_GHOSTS), positioned via scale.toX(midpoint). Click → TimelineCanvas-hosted PromptDialog via fillGapSpec/buildFillGapPrompt (add_node, date-range scoped); verb_prompt_copied verb_id:'fill-gap'+years+surface:'canvas_gap'. Filled gap closes itself (re-derived each memo). typecheck + build green. FOLLOW-UP (small): collapse-mode currently hides ghosts; making the collapsed-range marker itself the fill affordance is deferred. Spec: docs/product/prd/next5-tier2-alive-canvas.md.

data.title: Implement VERBS-T2 empty-lane + bare-era invitations (variants)
data.description: Same ghost-card primitive as local-74, different targets: empty/sparse lanes (from layout-report lanes.fragments) → 'Add to {lane}' ghost (buildExtendLanePrompt, add_node+lane); bare eras (from eras[].nodesWithin) → 'Populate {era}' affordance on the period node (buildPopulateEraPrompt, add_node + opt write_story). GapInvitationNode gets a `variant` prop. Depends on the gap primitive landing.

data.title: Landing page: feature + link the gap-fill demo
data.description: Add a section to src/components/home/Landing.tsx — 'Watch the canvas fill its own gaps' — featuring/linking the 60-second demo recording (local-61). If cheap, make HeroPreview/LiveTimeline show a ghost card filling in its loop so the landing page demonstrates the differentiator. Prereq: the demo recording (local-61). Spec: docs/product/prd/next5-tier2-alive-canvas.md → The demo centerpiece.

data.title: Implement NEXT.4 — Postgres + self-host path (Docker Compose)
data.description: Drizzle adapter swap (schema already portable), single Docker Compose (app + Postgres + auto-migration), issue:key works in Docker. Proves bet B7's first seam.

data.title: Implement S4 — witness mode (interior monologues)
data.description: S4.1 interior_monologues table; S4.2 lazy-generate-on-tap + cache; S4.3 witness UX. Requires S2 + S3. Refs: docs/product/prd/s4-witness-mode.md.

data.title: Implement L — Living Timelines (per-timeline agentic keeper)
data.description: Umbrella for L.1-L.6 (#local-50..55 in roadmap prose): timeline_agents schema, agent_runs + proposed-Patch review queue, local-first runner, grounded ingestion to S2 artifacts, Historian/Watcher personas, dashboard. Gated: does not start until the demo is made and S1+S2 feel lovable. Second-wave persona (analysts) rides on this.

data.title: Implement LATER.3 — telemetry opt-in (self-hoster count)
data.description: Fully opt-in telemetry; would also upgrade lovable-gate measurement from self-report. Roadmap 2.6.

data.description: BYO SYNEK_IMAGE_* key, one undoable Patch, provenance + cache, labelled as illustration. Deferred within NOW; revisit only when a real timeline cannot be illustrated from sourced images.

data.body: Wrote docs/product/prd/next5-verb-system.md (VERBS), distilling the roadmap NEXT.5 section into a house-format PRD: the object+intent->PromptSpec->MCP-tool primitive, Interact/Expand families, the Tier 1-4 catalogue, registry architecture (src/lib/verbs.ts feeding panel + ⌘K), and Tier-1 Done-when. data.title: S3.4 Talk-to shipped (build-verified) — 2026-06-12
data.body: local-65 done at the data/build layer (live in-browser pass owed, covered by local-62). Created src/lib/verbs.ts as the shared verb-spec registry seed (talkToSpec, improveTimelineSpec) with a surface tag on the copy analytics ('command_palette' vs 'node_panel') so bet B5 copy-rates read per-surface. CommandPalette now reads verbs.ts (no behavior change). NodeDetailPanel: 'Talk to {name}' button on entity panels (owner, read mode, after dateline) opening the shared PromptDialog — closes the founder-named gap (Talk-to was ⌘K-only). My files typecheck-clean; build green (3.07s). NOTE: repo typecheck is red on src/lib/db/patches.ts:49 — the founder's in-flight S2.2 added storyArtifacts/segmentCitations to StorySnapshot (schema.ts) but the snapshot capture isn't updated yet (the ADR-0001 landmine). Not mine; left for the S2 track. local-66 (Tier 1 row) extends verbs.ts into a showWhen descriptor registry + NodeVerbBar.

data.title: NEXT.5 Tier 1 verb batch shipped — 2026-06-12
data.body: local-66 done (build-verified). Completed the Tier 1 verb catalogue: verbs.ts is now a real descriptor registry (showWhen + makeSpec + icon + keywords), 5 node verbs total. Next lovable batch when Tier 1 copy-rates land: Tier 2 'alive canvas' — Gap invitations (dashed ghost-cards over axis dead zones from get_layout_report), Populate/extend era, Add a rival track (the demo centerpiece, higher effort).
